Adrienne passes sentence on one creature. Its weapon damage is halved, it can no longer land a Critical Hit or use Reactions, and it becomes Vulnerable to[1].

The sentence lasts until Adrienne is killed.

Weapon damage is halved. Cannot land a Critical Hit. Cannot use Reactions. Vulnerable to[1].

Ends only when Adrienne is killed.
Black frost covers Adrienne. A creature that hits her with a melee attack additionally takes[2] equal to [1]% of its own maximum Hit Points.
